thread:
maria: Anyone else seeing a sudden spike in GPU pod evictions in eu-west2? lots of tiny pods stuck Pending, big training pods getting evicted.
kevin: yup noticed ~100 pod evicts starting ~08:12 UTC, scheduler logs show 'Insufficient gpu' even though nodes have free memory.
ash: could be fragmentation from the new mixed-node pool we added yesterday, different GPU stride/shape.
maria: cluster autoscaler also flapping, warmpools not filling. odd thing: pods with nodeAffinity to 'nvlink=true' are being scheduled off the nvlink nodes.
jon: sharing scheduler log snippet:
```
I0314 08:12:34.123 scheduler_pred.go:456] preemption: candidate nodes sorted by score: ...
pod small-worker (0.1gpu) can't fit due to 'resource cpu/gpu' but allocatable shows gpu free:2
```
kevin: looks like our admission webhook that normalizes fractional GPU requests started rounding up in a way that breaks slot accounting; new admission change landed yesterday.
maria: can we roll back the mutatingwebhook? I think that's the easiest mitigation for now.
ash: rolling rollback on staging now. patch command: `kubectl delete mutatingwebhookconfiguration pod-gpu-normalizer-temp`
infra-bot: rollout started for mutatingwebhook/pod-gpu-normalizer-temp -> observed 6/6 updated
kevin: temporary workaround: mark a couple big jobs as critical so they aren't preempted: `kubectl annotate pod <job> scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/critical-pod=true`
maria: also increasing warmpool size in eu-west2 to 8 GPUs to soak small pods while we stabilize, ops aware this will increase spend.
jon: FYI preemption trace shows affinity weight miscomputed when node has mixed gpu flavors, scoring function divides by `numFreeSlots` and hits integer truncation -> 0 score for affinity nodes.
ash: opening a PR to fix scoring heuristics; hotfix that helps immediate pain is to restart scheduler with `--feature-gates=MixedGpuAffinityWorkaround=true`.
maria: do the flag, restart 3 schedulers, and watch evictions metric `cluster.scheduler.evictions_per_min`.
kevin: deployed flag to schedulers in eu-west2, restarting pods 1/3 -> 3/3. watching metrics.
sre-oncall: alerting updated: Sev2 if evictions > 50/min sustained for 10m.
kevin: metrics trending down, evictions dropped from ~120/min to ~4/min in last 6m. warm pools are filling.
maria: great. keep the webhook rollback until the scoring fix merges and we can validate on staging. cost note: warmpool bump ~€1.2/hr, plan horizon 28h -> est cost ~€34.
nash: filing issue with repro steps, attaching scheduler logs and a reduced test job. I'll include the PR link when ready.
maria: thanks all — tag me on the PR and let's do a quick postmortem doc in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
